a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Habitation Ring curves overhead: a city of apartments, shops and parks, lit in soft purple dusk. It is completely silent.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Ten thousand beds up here. Everyone was supposed to wake up in this place. It looks like a city holding its breath.

c.speaker: halcyon
c.text: Warning. Hull breach detected on the main street. Atmosphere venting.

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: Breach is at the west end of the main street. Let's patch it before we pass out. The lift up is past the park, through the holo-theater.

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: A holo-projector from the theater! I can project a hologram of myself. A handsome, dazzling, irresistible hologram.

d.speaker: narrator
d.name: New ability
d.text: BOLT learned DECOY: every enemy attack targets BOLT for 2 turns. Keep BOLT's health up!

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: An old man sits in his armchair with a blanket over his knees. Bloom spots spread across his hands like lichen. He's awake, and smiling.

b.speaker: hollis
b.name: Hollis
b.text: Well. Visitors. Forgive me for not getting up. The fungus has opinions about my knees.

c.speaker: hollis
c.name: Hollis
c.text: Hollis Grant. Forty years mining asteroids, and a flower gets me. They say a serum stops it. I'd need an arm to lean on to reach the shelter, too.

again.speaker: hollis
again.name: Hollis
again.text: Still here. The flowers are coming along nicely, if you're into that sort of thing.

choices.text: Give him a serum and help him to the shelter (2h)

saved.speaker: hollis
saved.name: Hollis
saved.text: Ha! I feel twenty years younger. Well, nineteen. Take these, I won't need them. And kid? Mind the big lady in the park. She's the one who took the neighbors.

leave.speaker: hollis
leave.name: Hollis
leave.text: Don't apologize. You've got a whole ship on your back. Go on.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: Behind the last row of seats, a girl with a flashlight is curled up in a blanket fort. She points the light straight at BOLT.

b.speaker: juno
b.name: Juno
b.text: Are you a robot? Are you a good robot or a bad robot?

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: I'm a GREAT robot. The best one. Ask anyone. Well, don't, they're all asleep.

d.speaker: juno
d.name: Juno
d.text: I'm Juno. Mom went to the store and didn't come back, so I'm waiting. The glowing lady in the park waves at me through the window. With lights.

e.speaker: juno
e.name: Juno
e.text: I figured out how to wave back. Blue, blue, yellow! I think it means hi.

again.speaker: juno
again.name: Juno
again.text: You came back! Is it time to go now?

ask.speaker: juno
ask.name: Juno
ask.text: The shelter's really far and it's really dark out there.

choices.text: Let's get you to the shelter, Juno (1h)
Stay hidden. I'll come back for you.

saved.speaker: juno
saved.name: Juno
saved.text: Okay. But BOLT has to hold my hand. Wait, do you have hands? ...Here. A star sticker, for being brave.

saved2.speaker: bolt
saved2.text: I have been awarded a STAR. Kai. KAI. Look at my star.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The park fountain has become a nest. In its center sways the Hive Matron: dozens of infected colonists woven into one flowering body. Her many faces turn toward you.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Oh no. Kai, those are the neighbors. The people from the apartments.

c.speaker: kai
c.text: I know. We can't help them like this. Maybe if we stop what's controlling them...

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: She'll keep birthing spore swarms and feeding on them. Thin out the swarms, and burn her!

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Matron shudders and comes apart in a rain of petals. For a moment, the faces look peaceful.

c.speaker: kai
c.text: Me neither. Come on. The junction is behind the gate.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Ring's power junction is a mess of scorched breakers and Bloom tendrils. Restoring it will reconnect the lift to the Security Deck.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Lights on in the Ring! Somewhere out there, a vending machine just rebooted and it is very, very happy.

off.speaker: narrator
off.text: The lift is dark. The Ring's power junction is offline.

a.speaker: halcyon
a.text: Lift to the Security Deck ready. This lift only travels up. You will not be able to return to the Ring.

choices.text: Go up to the Security Deck
